decisions.decision: Use one compact seven-part page led by less scattered work.
decisions.rationale: Everyday teachers need an outcome and clear task model before capability detail.

decisions.decision: Use three separate positive synthetic scenarios after GA claims are confirmed.
decisions.rationale: Separate scenarios avoid a fictional integrated workflow and improve public-clearance suitability.

decisions.decision: Reject four challenged claims unless owners record new evidence.
decisions.rationale: The shared CMS comments challenge circular reading, automatic bursary matching, application outcome tracking, and student-context drafting.

decisions.decision: Keep the released homepage and current CMS candidate untouched until the gates clear.
decisions.rationale: This preserves production and all colleague feedback while the team resolves product truth.
